summary: Triaged all 67 p6-autopoiesis experiments by ripgrep citation analysis across Paper/ and experiments/, counting per-occurrence references to each experiment's slug and dotted ID (excluding self-references), and flagging which are cited by theory objects (Paper/theory/objects/), paper dossiers (Paper/papers/), and the evidence-map. Result: 20 canonical, 39 superseded, 8 design-only. The citation data strongly validates the strong prior: all 20 prior-canonical experiments occupy the top of the citation ranking and none is contradicted. The decisive signal is theory-object by-ID citation: only 6.1, 6.59, 6.63, 6.64, 6.65, 6.66, 6.67 are named by ID inside theory objects (6.64/6.65 across 6 objects each) — all in the prior set. The next tier (6.2=28, 6.59=27, 6.1=27, 6.63=21, 6.53=20, 6.26=19, 6.3=18 paper-dossier files) confirms the rest of the canonical set. Borderline-but-retained per prior: 6.50 (7 paper files, minimal-effective trigger) and 6.54 (4 paper files, fresh local-body offspring) — both kept as distinct phenotypes, consistent with Appendix B which already flagged them borderline. Superseded = the ablation-ladder/pressure replicates (6.6-6.28, 6.36-6.44, 6.46-6.47, 6.49, 6.51, 6.52, 6.55-6.57, 6.61). Design-only = the 6.29-6.35 single-axis transmutation series (branch-logic, interface-hygiene, task-structure, identity, habitat-physics, invariants, runtime-physics), which are near-duplicate redesign variants with 0-2 paper citations and no theory by-ID cite. Caveats: (1) every experiment has >=1 DVC run pointer, so none qualifies as design-only via 'never produced a stable run' — design-only here means near-duplicate only. (2) The dotted-id occurrence count is noise-prone for single-digit suffixes (6.1-6.9), where bare '6.8'-style numbers in unrelated prose inflate counts (6.8 showed 805); for those nine ids citation_count uses the noise-free per-occurrence slug count instead. (3) No disagreement with the prior was found; the data confirms it on every point including the v1->v2 additions (6.26, 6.48, 6.62, 6.66, 6.68 all show strong paper/theory citation). Full per-experiment raw counts: /tmp/phase0/p6-citation-raw.tsv. JSON: /tmp/phase0/audit-p6triage.json.
